contract: DROffline MkII 2.2.3 per-file DR/LUFS/TPL pipeline, recovered by REA/Ghidra static analysis
status: partial; differential model reproduces 23/23 reference rows for TPL, LUFSi and DR

oversampling.filter: ITU-R BS.1770 Annex 2 48-tap, 4 phases x 12 taps

true_peak.per_channel: max(|min|,|max|) of oversampled buffer, max over chunks
true_peak.max_tpl_db: 20*log10(max over channels); if <= 0 or <= -100 -> -100; NOT capped at 0

per_block_channel.peak2: max(float32(x*x)); if peak2 > 0.9999 and exactly 2 equal repeats followed the running max -> 1.0
per_block_channel.rms2: 2 * sum(x^2) / n, n = actual block frames

dr.histogram_bin: v <= 1e-8 -> 9999 else trunc(-1000*log10(v)); clamp 0..9000 (0.01 dB, floor -90 dB, values > 0 dB clamp to 0)
dr.channel_dr: -0.01*bin(second-highest block peak) - 10*log10( sum_topbins(10^(-bin/1000)*taken) / n20 ), n20 = max(1, trunc(0.2*blocks))
dr.album: mean of unrounded composite DRs of accepted tracks (>= 2 tracks), then roundToInt (half to even)
dr.display_rounding: integer, round half to even (inferred from shared roundToInt; no .5 tie in corpus)
dr.evidence: DLL processBlock 0x180051a00, FUN_180051ea0, getDR 0x180051800, getCompositDR 0x1800514f0, getAlbumDR 0x180051480; EXE FUN_1401525c0, FUN_140013a90

loudness.k_weighting: hard-coded float biquads for 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000, 176400, 192000, 352800 (HPF) / 354800 (shelf, typo), 384000; others -> FUN_18002a000 (undecoded)
loudness.integrated: abs list = windows with L > -70; Gr = L(mean abs list) - 10; LUFSi = L(mean of ALL windows with L > Gr); L(p) = 10*log10(p) - 0.691; p <= 0 -> -128
loudness.evidence: DLL prepareForOffline 0x1800540f0, FUN_180052310, hiResTimerCallback 0x1800531f0, FUN_180003ee0, FUN_180004270, getCombinedLUFSValue 0x180053de0, getChannelLUFSValue 0x180053ef0

other_per_file.lra: getLRA_dB high - low (10 % / 95 % percentile indices of short-term windows)

report_default_txt.trailing: no extra empty line after album line
